title: Perceiving and Acting in First-Person: A Dataset and Benchmark for Egocentric Human-Object-Human Interactions
title_zh: 第一人称感知与行动：面向自我中心人-物-人交互的数据集与基准
abstract: Learning action models from real-world human-centric interaction datasets is important towards building generalpurpose intelligent assistants with efficiency. However, most existing datasets only offer specialist interaction category and ignore that AI assistants perceive and act based on first-person acquisition. We urge that both the generalist interaction knowledge and egocentric modality are indispensable. In this paper, we embed the manual-assisted task into a vision-language-action framework, where the assistant provides services to the instructor following egocentric vision and commands. With our hybrid RGB-MoCap system, pairs of assistants and instructors engage with multi-ple objects and the scene following GPT-generated scripts. Under this setting, we accomplish InterVLA, the first largescale human-object-human interaction dataset with 11.4 hours and 1.2M frames of multimodal data, spanning 2 egocentric and 5 exocentric videos, accurate human/object motions and verbal commands. Furthermore, we establish novel benchmarks on egocentric human motion estimation, interaction synthesis, and interaction prediction with comprehensive analysis. We believe that our InterVLA testbed and the benchmarks will foster future works on building AI agents in the physical world.
abstract_zh: 从真实世界的人类中心交互数据集中学习动作模型，对于构建高效的全能智能助手至关重要。然而，现有的大多数数据集仅提供专业化的交互类别，忽略了AI助手基于第一人称采集进行感知和行动。我们认为，通用交互知识和自我中心模态两者缺一不可。在本文中，我们将人工辅助任务嵌入到视觉-语言-动作框架中，其中助手遵循自我中心视觉和指令为操作者提供服务。通过我们的混合RGB-MoCap系统，助手和操作者按照GPT生成的脚本与多个物体和场景进行交互。在此设置下，我们构建了InterVLA，这是首个大规模的人-物-人交互数据集，包含11.4小时和120万帧的多模态数据，涵盖2个自我中心和5个外部视角视频，以及精确的人体/物体运动和口头指令。此外，我们建立了关于自我中心人体运动估计、交互合成和交互预测的新基准，并进行了全面分析。我们相信，我们的InterVLA测试平台和基准将促进未来在物理世界中构建AI代理的研究。
tldr_zh: 首个大规模第一人称人-物-人交互数据集InterVLA及基准，推动通用智能助手发展。
cover_zh: AI助手终于能看懂第一视角？InterVLA数据集让交互理解更近一步
